description: For engine plugins: tells the site the chosen sounds were installed in the project now, so the site can show which changes already reached the game. Plugin flow, in order: sync_scenes (the plugin sends its scenes), game_scenes (see what arrived), place_scenes (turn them into entities), mark_installed (the plugin reports the install).

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

name: mark_installed
title: Sounds installed in the engine
